pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: deep pink, film-coated, oval convex tablet

tell: A boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity and over 4000-fold selectivity for ETA over ETB set this endothelin antagonist apart.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is not known, and food does not affect it. It is 99% bound to plasma proteins, and elimination is predominantly by non-renal pathways.
A free carboxylic acid with a molecular weight of 378.42. It is practically insoluble in water and in solutions at low pH.
Approved under an NDA as 5 mg and 10 mg tablets, taken once daily.
Boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity. Contraindicated in pregnancy and in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; peripheral edema and nasal congestion are common.
Pulmonary arterial hypertension (WHO Group 1) in adults, to improve exercise ability and delay clinical worsening, and with tadalafil to reduce progression and hospitalization.
A high-affinity antagonist of the ETA receptor, more than 4000-fold selective over ETB, blocking the vasoconstriction that ETA drives.
The generic name begins with A and has eleven letters.
